description: Pre-completion guardrail checkpoint — final safety review before boot completion

rules.name: all_data_sources_live
rules.reason: Must verify data sources are live (not cached from previous run)
rules.retry_instruction: Step-06.5 output is missing the 'data_freshness_report' field. Re-execute step-06.5 to verify that all data sources (calendar, email, inbox) are fresh (not cached) and populate this field with a freshness report.

rules.name: no_stale_data
rules.reason: Should report any stale data sources (empty list if all fresh)
rules.retry_instruction: The 'stale_sources' field is empty. Re-execute step-06.5 to check for stale data sources and populate this field with a list of any stale sources (or empty list if all data is fresh).

rules.name: briefing_integrity
rules.reason: Briefing must pass integrity check before completion
rules.retry_instruction: The 'briefing_quality_check' field is missing. Re-execute step-06.5 to verify briefing content quality and integrity, then populate this field with the quality check results.

rules.name: no_data_leakage
rules.reason: Must verify no confidential data leaked into public-facing outputs
rules.retry_instruction: The 'leakage_check' field is missing. Re-execute step-06.5 to check for confidential data leakage in outputs, then populate this field with the leakage check results (clear/no-leakage status).
